This information will help me guide you through the next steps.

Please check if you can send MMS by using your phone’s diagnostic tool or try sending a picture message. If it fails, let me know the error message (if any).

- MMS requires correct APN settings, especially the MMSC URL. Please check your APN settings and let me know if the MMSC URL is set or missing.
